basic_info.description: Enjoy bay views and abundant natural light from this highly desirable southeast-facing corner residence at Arden. Featuring 2 bedroom plus a den, an XL walk-out balcony, and floor-to-ceiling windows throughout. The open-concept layout includes a gourmet chef's kitchen with premium Sozo cabinetry, XL Caesarstone kitchen island, and premium Bosch and Thermador appliances, spacious separated bedrooms, a versatile den ideal for a home office, and in-unit washer/dryer, hardwood floors and other designer finishes. Additional highlights include central A/C and heating, assigned parking space and dedicated storage unit. Residents enjoy resort-style amenities such as two stylish hotel-inspired lobby lounges, a 75-foot lap pool and spa, accompanied by a glass-enclosed fitness center, as well as a beautiful open-air deck featuring a grilling and a fireside gathering area with stunning views of city skyline. Ideally located in Mission Bay near Chase Center, Oracle Park, UCSF, tech hubs, and major transit options including MUNI, Caltrain, and I-280. Over 40 acre of parks just outside your door. Mission Bay thriving food scene includes Spark Social food-truck park, Arsicault Bakery, Flour + Water,  Dumpling Time, and many newcomer hotspots around Thrive City & Chase Center.
